```{r setup}
#| include: false

# Packages. To install any that are missing:
# install.packages(c("here", "readr", "dplyr", "tidyr", "DT", "crosstalk", "htmltools"))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(here)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(DT)
  library(crosstalk)
  library(htmltools)
})

# ---- CUSTOMIZE: data file and settings ------------------------------------
data_file     <- here("data", "Metadata_E4.csv")
data_file_url <- "data/Metadata_E4.csv"  # link for the "Full CSV" button, relative to the rendered HTML
search_end    <- "August 2026"

# Columns shown in the table by default; the rest are one click away under "Columns".
default_columns <- c(
  "Study_ID", "Publication_year", "Authors", "Title", "Country", "Habitat",
  "Target_group", "Scale_class", "SAC_detected", "SAC_method", "DOI"
)

# Columns with several comma-separated values per cell. They get a text
# filter ("contains") instead of a drop-down.
multi_value_columns <- c("SAC_objective", "Spatial_metric", "SAC_method",
                         "Process_inferred", "Factor_affecting_SAC")

# Long text, truncated in the table (full text in the row details and downloads)
long_text_columns <- c("Title", "Notes", "Toponym")

# ---- Read the data --------------------------------------------------------
# "NA" in the sheet means "the coder looked and there was nothing to record";
# it is treated as missing, like an empty cell. Empty spreadsheet rows are dropped.
sac_raw <- read_csv(data_file, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                    na = c("", "NA"), locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")) |>
  filter(!is.na(Study_ID))

number_columns <- c("Publication_year", "Number_of_sites", "Number_of_data",
                    "Number_of_water_bodies", "SAC_range_value_m")

sac <- sac_raw |>
  mutate(across(any_of(number_columns), as.numeric))

# ---- Data dictionary -------------------------------------------------------
# CUSTOMIZE: check these against your coding protocol.
dictionary <- tribble(
  ~column, ~description,
  "Study_ID", "Identifier of the source publication. A study can contribute several analyses, so the same Study ID can appear on several rows.",
  "Analysis_ID", "Identifier of the analysis (one row). Equal to the Study ID when a study contributes one analysis; otherwise the Study ID plus a suffix (for example _a, _b or _lake).",
  "DOI", "Digital Object Identifier of the publication, shown as a link.",
  "Title", "Title of the publication.",
  "Publication_year", "Year of publication.",
  "Journal", "Journal in which the study was published.",
  "Authors", "First author, followed by \"et al.\" when there are more than two authors.",
  "Continent", "Continent of the study area. \"Multiple\" means the study spans several continents.",
  "Country", "Country of the study area. \"Multiple\" means several countries or a global dataset.",
  "Toponym", "Place name(s) of the study area, as reported by the authors.",
  "Climatic_region", "Broad climatic region of the study area, from polar to tropical. \"Multiple\" means the study covers several regions.",
  "Freshwater_realm", "Lotic (running water), lentic (standing water), groundwater, or multiple realms.",
  "Habitat", "Habitat type sampled. \"Multiple\" means several habitat types; \"Reservoire\" is reservoir.",
  "Human_stressors", "Main human stressor considered by the study, if any (for example damming, nutrient enrichment, invasive species).",
  "Target_group", "Organism group analysed.",
  "Target_level", "Level of biological organisation analysed: community or population.",
  "Taxonomic_res", "Taxonomic resolution of the biological data (species, genus, family, order or higher, molecular OTUs or ASVs, mixed \"taxa\", or multiple).",
  "ID_method", "How organisms were identified: morphological, molecular, remote sensing, or multiple methods.",
  "Network_position", "Position of the sampled reaches in the river network (for example headwaters, entire river segment, large river). Usually missing for standing waters.",
  "Land_use", "Dominant land use around the study sites: natural, agricultural, urban or mixed.",
  "Response_category", "Biological response analysed. Beta-div = beta diversity; P/A = presence/absence.",
  "Response_data_type", "Statistical type of the response variable: dissimilarity, continuous, count, binary or proportion.",
  "Study_extent", "Spatial extent of the study as reported, usually the maximum distance between sites in km (some entries are areas in km² or a description).",
  "Scale_class", "Spatial scale class of the study: local, landscape, regional or continental.",
  "Number_of_sites", "Number of sampling sites.",
  "Number_of_data", "Number of observations (samples or data points) in the analysis.",
  "Number_of_water_bodies", "Number of distinct water bodies sampled.",
  "Temporal_design", "Sampling through time: a single sampling, repeated seasonally, repeated annually, or long-term. \"Repeted\" is \"repeated\".",
  "SAC_role", "How the study treated spatial autocorrelation: as an ecological signal of interest, as a statistical challenge to be accounted for, or both.",
  "SAC_objective", "Purpose(s) of the SAC analysis: detect or describe spatial structure, infer ecological processes, account for non-independence, prediction, or other.",
  "SAC_detected", "Whether spatial autocorrelation was detected (yes or no).",
  "SAC_direction", "Direction of the autocorrelation found: positive, negative, both, or NS (not significant).",
  "Spatial_metric", "Distance or connectivity measure(s) used to relate sites: geographic, Euclidean, network (along the watercourse), resistance/cost, adjacency/neighbourhood, elevation, other or unclear.",
  "Directionality_considered", "Whether directional (for example upstream-downstream) spatial dependence was considered. \"Not applicable\" where flow direction does not apply.",
  "SAC_method", "Method(s) used to detect, measure or model SAC (for example distance-decay models, Mantel-type tests, spatial eigenvectors, Moran's I, correlograms, variograms).",
  "Residual_SAC_tested", "Whether model residuals were tested for remaining spatial autocorrelation.",
  "SAC_range_value_m", "Reported range of spatial autocorrelation (the distance up to which observations are correlated), in metres.",
  "Process_inferred", "Ecological process(es) the authors inferred from the spatial pattern (for example species sorting, dispersal limitation, mass effects, neutral processes).",
  "Factor_affecting_SAC", "Factor(s) reported to affect the strength or range of SAC (for example environmental heterogeneity, spatial scale, dispersal ability).",
  "Sampling_recommendation_provided", "Whether the study gives recommendations for sampling design (for example site spacing): yes, no or unclear.",
  "Notes", "Free-text notes from the coder."
)

# ---- Helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------
fmt <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE)

stat_card <- function(value, label) {
  div(class = "stat-card",
      span(class = "stat-value", value),
      span(class = "stat-label", label))
}

doi_link <- function(x) {
  doi <- sub("^.*?(10\\.\\d{4,9}/\\S+)$", "\\1", x, perl = TRUE)
  url <- paste0("https://doi.org/", doi)
  ifelse(is.na(x), NA_character_,
         sprintf('<a href="%s" target="_blank" rel="noopener">%s</a>',
                 htmlEscape(url, attribute = TRUE), htmlEscape(doi)))
}

# DataTables styling that matches the Bootstrap 5 page (older DT versions only have bootstrap4)
dt_style <- if ("bootstrap5" %in% tryCatch(DT:::DTStyles(), error = function(e) character())) "bootstrap5" else "bootstrap4"

# Summary numbers for the header cards
n_analyses  <- nrow(sac)
n_studies   <- n_distinct(sac$Study_ID)
n_countries <- n_distinct(sac$Country[!is.na(sac$Country) & sac$Country != "Multiple"])
year_range  <- paste(range(sac$Publication_year, na.rm = TRUE), collapse = "–")
n_range     <- sum(!is.na(sac$SAC_range_value_m))
```

## About the database

This page accompanies a systematic review of how spatial autocorrelation (SAC) is detected, measured,
modelled and accounted for in freshwater ecology. Each row of the database is one **analysis**; a
study can contribute several. Every analysis is coded for geography, habitat, organism group,
sampling design, the SAC method used, and what the authors concluded. The literature search runs to
`r search_end`.

::: callout-tip
## How to use this page

- **Filter** with the drop-downs and the publication-year range (drag the slider or type the years)
  in the panel above the table. Filters combine
  (AND); choosing several values in one drop-down matches any of them.
- **Search** every column at once with the search box, or a single column with the boxes under the
  column headers.
- **Sort** by clicking a column header. Shift-click a second header to sort by both.
- **Details** on any row shows all `r ncol(sac)` fields for that analysis.
- **Download** the rows that match your filters with **Filtered CSV** or **Filtered Excel** (every
  matching row and every column, not just the current page), or get everything with **Full dataset**.
- **Columns** shows or hides columns. Everything works with the keyboard: Tab between controls,
  Enter or Space to open a drop-down or sort a column.
:::

## Explore the data
```{r shared-data}
display_columns <- c(default_columns, setdiff(names(sac), default_columns))

# Repair invalid UTF-8 characters before creating the interactive table
repair_utf8 <- function(x) {
  if (is.character(x)) {
    iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte")
  } else if (is.factor(x)) {
    factor(iconv(as.character(x), from = "UTF-8", to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte"))
  } else {
    x
  }
}

sac <- sac |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character) | where(is.factor), repair_utf8))

table_data <- sac |>
  mutate(
    DOI = doi_link(DOI),
    across(where(is.character) & !any_of(c("DOI", multi_value_columns, long_text_columns,
                                           "Study_ID", "Analysis_ID", "Authors", "Journal",
                                           "Toponym", "Study_extent")),
           as.factor)
  ) |>
  select(all_of(display_columns)) |>
  mutate(.row_key = paste0(Analysis_ID, "__", row_number()), .before = 1)

sd <- SharedData$new(table_data, key = ~.row_key, group = "sac")
```

```{r table}
col_index <- function(cols) which(names(table_data) %in% cols) - 1   # 0-based, includes .row_key
hidden    <- col_index(setdiff(display_columns, default_columns))
long_idx  <- col_index(long_text_columns)
wide_idx  <- col_index(c(multi_value_columns, "Toponym", "Journal"))
num_idx   <- col_index(number_columns)

# column 0 (the internal row key) is displayed as a "Details" button,
# named after the analysis so screen readers can tell the buttons apart
analysis_idx <- col_index("Analysis_ID")
details_render <- JS(sprintf(
  "function(d, type, row) { if (type !== 'display') return ''; var id = $('<div>').html(row[%d]).text().replace(/[^\\w.-]/g, '');
   return '<button type=\"button\" class=\"btn btn-sm btn-quiet dt-details\" aria-expanded=\"false\" aria-label=\"Details for ' + id + '\">Details</button>'; }",
  analysis_idx))

export_opts <- list(
  columns = ":not(.no-export)",          # every data column, including hidden ones
  modifier = list(search = "applied"),   # only rows matching the filters
  orthogonal = "export"                  # full text, not the truncated display
)

datatable(
  sd,
  filter = "top",
  rownames = FALSE,
  escape = setdiff(names(table_data), "DOI"),
  style = dt_style,
  class = "table table-sm table-hover",
  extensions = c("Buttons"),
  plugins = "ellipsis",
  selection = "none",
  options = list(
    dom = "<'d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-start gap-2'Bf>rt<'d-flex flex-wrap justify-content-between align-items-center gap-2 mt-2'lip>",
    pageLength = 25,
    lengthMenu = list(c(10, 25, 50, 100, -1), c("10", "25", "50", "100", "All")),
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    searchDelay = 250,
    order = list(),
    language = list(search = "Search all columns:", searchPlaceholder = "e.g. diatoms Mantel"),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = 0, visible = TRUE, searchable = FALSE, orderable = FALSE,
           className = "no-export dt-details-col", title = "",
           render = details_render),
      list(targets = hidden, visible = FALSE),
      list(targets = long_idx, className = "dt-long",
           render = JS("$.fn.dataTable.render.ellipsis(90, true, false)")),
      list(targets = wide_idx, className = "dt-wide"),
      list(targets = num_idx, className = "dt-right"),
      list(targets = col_index(c("DOI", "Study_ID", "Analysis_ID", "Authors")), className = "text-nowrap")
    ),
    buttons = list(
      list(extend = "csv", text = "⬇ Filtered CSV", className = "btn-sm dl-btn",
           titleAttr = "Download the rows matching the current filters as CSV (all columns)",
           filename = "spatial_autocorrelation_filtered", exportOptions = export_opts),
      list(extend = "excel", text = "⬇ Filtered Excel", className = "btn-sm dl-btn",
           titleAttr = "Download the rows matching the current filters as an Excel file (all columns)",
           filename = "spatial_autocorrelation_filtered", title = "", exportOptions = export_opts),
      list(extend = "copy", text = "Copy", className = "btn-sm",
           titleAttr = "Copy the rows matching the current filters to the clipboard", title = "", exportOptions = export_opts),
      list(extend = "colvis", text = "Columns ▾", className = "btn-sm",
           columns = ":not(.no-export)", collectionLayout = "two-column"),
      list(extend = "colvisGroup", text = "Default columns", className = "btn-sm",
           show = col_index(default_columns), hide = hidden)
    )
  ),
  callback = JS("
    // ---- row details: every field of the analysis ----
    table.on('click', 'button.dt-details', function () {
      var btn = $(this), tr = btn.closest('tr'), row = table.row(tr);
      if (row.child.isShown()) {
        row.child.hide();
        btn.attr('aria-expanded', 'false').text('Details');
        return;
      }
      var d = row.data(), html = '<dl class=\"row-details\">';
      table.columns().every(function (i) {
        if (i < 1) return;                                  // column 0 = button (internal row key)
        var name = $(this.header()).text(), v = d[i];
        if (v === null || v === undefined || v === '') v = '<span class=\"text-body-secondary\">—</span>';
        var wide = typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 140 ? ' class=\"wide\"' : '';
        html += '<div' + wide + '><dt>' + name + '</dt><dd>' + v + '</dd></div>';
      });
      row.child(html + '</dl>', 'row-details-cell').show();
      btn.attr('aria-expanded', 'true').text('Hide');
    });

    // ---- live count of matching analyses and studies ----
    var total = table.rows().count();
    function updateCount() {
      var rows = table.rows({ search: 'applied' }).data();
      var studies = {};
      rows.each(function (r) { studies[r[1]] = 1; });         // column 1 = Study_ID
      var n = rows.length, s = Object.keys(studies).length;
      var el = document.getElementById('result-count');
      if (el) el.innerHTML = 'Showing <strong>' + n.toLocaleString() + '</strong> of ' + total.toLocaleString() +
        ' analyses (<strong>' + s.toLocaleString() + '</strong> ' + (s === 1 ? 'study' : 'studies') + ')';
    }
    table.on('draw', updateCount);
    updateCount();

    // ---- give each column filter box a name screen readers can announce ----
    function labelColumnFilters() {
      var cells = $(table.table().container()).find('thead tr').eq(1).children();
      table.columns(':visible').every(function (n) {
        var name = $(this.header()).text().trim();
        var cell = cells.eq(n);
        if (!name) return;
        cell.find('input').attr('aria-label', 'Filter ' + name);
        cell.find('select').attr('aria-label', 'Filter ' + name);
      });
    }
    setTimeout(labelColumnFilters, 0);
    table.on('column-visibility.dt', function () { setTimeout(labelColumnFilters, 0); });

    // ---- reset every filter: crosstalk panel, column filters and global search ----
    $('#reset-all').on('click', function () {
      $('.crosstalk-input-select select').each(function () { if (this.selectize) this.selectize.clear(); });
      $('.crosstalk-input-slider input').each(function () {
        var s = $(this).data('ionRangeSlider');
        if (s) s.update({ from: s.options.min, to: s.options.max });   // fires the change crosstalk listens to
      });
      var head = $(table.table().container());
      head.find('thead input[type=search], thead input[type=text]').val('').trigger('input');
      head.find('thead select').each(function () { if (this.selectize) this.selectize.clear(); });
      head.find('.noUi-target').each(function () { if (this.noUiSlider) this.noUiSlider.reset(); });
      table.search('').columns().search('').draw();
    });
  ")
)
```

<div class="table-note">Filtered downloads contain every row that matches the current filters and search, with all `r ncol(sac)` columns, including hidden ones. Values are exported in full, not truncated. Hover over a truncated title, or use <strong>Details</strong>, to see all of it.</div>

## Data dictionary

One entry per column of the CSV, in file order. Values and completeness are computed from the data
file when this page is rendered, so they stay current when the data change. `NA` and empty cells
count as missing.

```{r dictionary}
summarise_values <- function(col, x) {
  present <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (!length(present)) return("No values")
  if (col %in% number_columns) {
    v <- as.numeric(present)
    f <- if (col == "Publication_year") as.character else fmt
    return(sprintf("Range %s to %s; median %s", f(min(v)), f(max(v)), f(median(v))))
  }
  if (col %in% multi_value_columns) present <- trimws(unlist(strsplit(present, ",")))
  counts <- sort(table(present), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(counts) > 25 || col %in% c(long_text_columns, "Study_ID", "Analysis_ID", "DOI",
                                        "Authors", "Journal", "Study_extent")) {
    return(sprintf("%s distinct values", fmt(length(counts))))
  }
  out <- paste0(names(counts), " (", counts, ")", collapse = " · ")
  if (col %in% multi_value_columns) out <- paste0("Several per row. ", out)
  out
}

column_type <- function(col, x) {
  if (col %in% number_columns) "Number"
  else if (col %in% multi_value_columns) "Multi-value"
  else if (col %in% c("Study_ID", "Analysis_ID", "DOI")) "Identifier"
  else if (n_distinct(x, na.rm = TRUE) <= 25) "Category"
  else "Text"
}

dict_table <- tibble(Column = names(sac_raw)) |>
  left_join(dictionary, by = c("Column" = "column")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    Description = coalesce(description, "No description yet."),
    Type = column_type(Column, sac_raw[[Column]]),
    Values = summarise_values(Column, sac_raw[[Column]]),
    Completeness = sprintf("%s of %s (%d%%)", fmt(sum(!is.na(sac_raw[[Column]]))), fmt(nrow(sac_raw)),
                           round(100 * mean(!is.na(sac_raw[[Column]]))))
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(Column, Description, Type, Values, Completeness)

datatable(
  dict_table,
  rownames = FALSE,
  style = dt_style,
  class = "table table-sm",
  selection = "none",
  options = list(
    dom = "ft",
    paging = FALSE,
    ordering = FALSE,
    autoWidth = FALSE,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    language = list(search = "Search the dictionary:"),
    columnDefs = list(
      list(targets = 0, render = JS("function(d, type) { return type === 'display' ? '<code>' + d + '</code>' : d; }")),
      list(targets = 3, className = "dict-values"),
      list(targets = 4, className = "text-nowrap")
    )
  )
)
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Accessibility helpers for the filter panel and the Quarto page furniture.
(function () {
  // "All" in empty filter drop-downs
  function placeholders() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.crosstalk-input-select select').forEach(function (el) {
      if (el.selectize) { el.selectize.settings.placeholder = 'All'; el.selectize.updatePlaceholder(); }
    });
  }
  // "From" and "To" year boxes for keyboard and screen-reader users, synced with the slider
  function yearInputs() {
    var box = document.getElementById('f_year');
    var $in = window.jQuery && jQuery(box).find('input').first();
    var sl = $in && $in.data('ionRangeSlider');
    if (!box || !sl || box.querySelector('.year-inputs')) return;
    var o = sl.options;
    var wrap = document.createElement('div');
    wrap.className = 'year-inputs';
    wrap.innerHTML =
      '<label>From <input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="year-from" min="' + o.min + '" max="' + o.max + '" step="1"></label>' +
      '<label>To <input type="number" class="form-control form-control-sm" id="year-to" min="' + o.min + '" max="' + o.max + '" step="1"></label>';
    box.appendChild(wrap);
    var from = document.getElementById('year-from'), to = document.getElementById('year-to');
    function show() { from.value = sl.result.from; to.value = sl.result.to; }
    function apply() {
      var f = Math.round(+from.value), t = Math.round(+to.value);
      if (!isFinite(f) || from.value === '') f = o.min;
      if (!isFinite(t) || to.value === '') t = o.max;
      f = Math.min(Math.max(f, o.min), o.max);
      t = Math.min(Math.max(t, o.min), o.max);
      if (f > t) { var x = f; f = t; t = x; }
      sl.update({ from: f, to: t });
      show();
    }
    from.addEventListener('change', apply);
    to.addEventListener('change', apply);
    $in.on('change', show);
    show();
    // the boxes are the accessible control; take the mouse-only slider out of the tab order
    jQuery(box).find('.irs-line').attr({ tabindex: '-1', 'aria-hidden': 'true' });
    $in.attr({ 'aria-hidden': 'true', tabindex: '-1' });
    jQuery(box).find('label.control-label').attr('for', 'year-from');
  }

  function quartoFixes() {
    document.querySelectorAll('.quarto-color-scheme-toggle').forEach(function (a) {
      a.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Switch between light and dark mode');
      a.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    });
    // the citation appendix marks an item as a list item without a list around it
    document.querySelectorAll('[role="listitem"]').forEach(function (li) {
      if (!li.parentElement.closest('[role="list"], ul, ol')) li.removeAttribute('role');
    });
  }

  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    setTimeout(function () { placeholders(); yearInputs(); quartoFixes(); }, 50);
  });
})();
</script>
```
